Class ConcurrencyHeaders

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.concurrency.ConcurrencyHeaders
public final class ConcurrencyHeaders extends Object
The names of the HTTP headers the multi-tab warning uses (issue #273), and the one rule about what a client may send.

The client names itself in a request header, and the server answers in two response headers, so that the answer can ride on any response (a save, a refused save, a heartbeat) without changing the shape of its body.
